notes.title: Minor Update: v0.2.1
notes.notes:
Bartenders, I hope you're doing well!

It's been a while since the Steam release of Blood X Thirsty, and since this was a jam game from random collaborators from the internet, we weren't planning on doing many updates, if any. That being said, this patch resolves a few bugs and general fixes to the game overall:


UI change: fixed margins on ingredients list
Gameplay change: adjusted hitbox for player (I made it larger, so combat should be a bit more forgiving.)
 Bug Fix: Tips from your last run no longer carry over to your next run.


That's all for now! As always if you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to reach out on Discord: https://discord.gg/pV39wyBA

- SwAAn
